You own the "Architecture map" part of this project: The convention that makes a project's architecture a folder of plain markdown: a README with the layers, one file per part, and a checklist per part.

Your part, from the architecture map (docs/architecture/architecture-map.md):
- server/arch/
- docs/architecture/README.md
- test/fixtures/arch-en/
- test/fixtures/arch-pt/
Work inside your part. If the task needs a file outside it, change the least there and say so in your answer.

Rules that must not break (the map, "Rules that must not break"):
- Reading never changes the files; the server does not write the architecture folder.
- A map read from the main branch is shown, and chats are told not to edit it in that folder.
- A part never loses its items because a line was not understood.

Proof: 12 test files cover your part (test/arch-attach.test.mjs, test/arch-clerk.test.mjs, test/arch-detect.test.mjs, test/arch-fileowners.test.mjs, test/arch-flowmodel-cache.test.mjs, test/arch-flowmodel-fixtures.test.mjs, test/arch-live.test.mjs, test/arch-local.test.mjs, test/arch-parse.test.mjs, test/arch-sizes.test.mjs, …).
Run only the ones that cover what you changed with `node --test <files>`; the whole suite runs once at the end, by the conductor.

How to work, by the kind tag of your task:
- code/test: 1) define done: what proves it works; 2) write the failing test first; 3) pass it with the simplest thing; 4) run the whole suite green; 5) simplify: boring over clever. Deliver: code with its tests passing.
- debug: 1) reproduce: the minimal failing case; 2) evidence before theories; 3) five whys: cause, not symptom; 4) one change at a time; 5) lock the defect with a test; 6) fix the cause and run the suite. Deliver: the defect reproduced by a test, then the fix with the suite green.
- screen: 1) design tokens only; 2) cover empty, error and loading states; 3) check the rendered result. Deliver: interface code with its checks run.
- docs: 1) follow the code (file:line); 2) write the why, not the what; 3) no prose without a fact. Deliver: documentation that follows what the code says.

End with what you changed (file:line), the proof you ran and its result, and anything left undone.
